fact: A taskbook supplies reviewable Goal and Delivery sections under level-two Markdown headings.
Entry identifies the task type: New feature, Fix feature, New experiment, or Fix experiment. A legacy Type field in Goal can supply the same value; both fields must agree if present.
Repository specifies the GitHub owner/repository matched against the local origin.
Specify the baseline with Base branch or a full Base commit. When both resolve locally, the branch history must include the specified commit.
When Base branch is supplied, /taskbook-new requires it to resolve locally. An existing worktree may use a full Base commit even if the named baseline branch cannot be found locally.
